subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new opt-in `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` config key and the associated late-side-effect fence semantics for deferred context-engine turn maintenance?
rationale: The code path is plausible and covered, but the permanent config surface and session-state behavior are compatibility/product choices that automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout surface
options.body: Merge this direction after maintainer review, keeping the default disabled and relying on the added fence/tests to protect configured deployments.

options.title: Reuse an existing safety budget
options.body: Ask for a replacement that bounds maintenance using the existing compaction timeout policy without adding a separate config key.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Keep the current unbounded behavior until maintainers choose a broader maintenance recovery design for the paired issue.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout surface
recommendation.body: Merge this direction after maintainer review, keeping the default disabled and relying on the added fence/tests to protect configured deployments.
